qualification.details: Guest Instructor (Dress Making): B.Voc/ Degree in Fashion & Apparel Technology from UGC recognized university OR Diploma (Minimum 2 years) in Dress Making/ Garment fabricating technology/ costume designing from recognized board of education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in Dress Making. Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (Fitter): B.Voc/ Degree in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/ recognized board of technical education OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Fitter". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (Sewing Technology): B.Voc/ Degree in Fashion & Apparel Technology from UGC recognized College/ university OR Diploma (Minimum 02 years) in Garment Fabrication Technology/ Costume Design & Dress Making from recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Sewing Technology" earlier named as "Cutting & Sewing". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (TWPT): B.Voc/ Degree in Textile Technology/ Textile Chemistry from AICTE/ UGC recognized university/ College OR 03 years Diploma in Textile Technology/ Textile Processing from AICTE recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Textile Wet Processing Technician". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC.

content_sections.heading: Govt ITI Boudh Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available - 1 for Guest Instructor (Dress Making), 1 for Guest Instructor (Fitter), 1 for Guest Instructor (Sewing Technology), 1 for Guest Instructor (TWPT), and 3 for other Guest Instructor posts.

content_sections.heading: Govt ITI Boudh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Guest Instructor (Dress Making): B.Voc/ Degree in Fashion & Apparel Technology from UGC recognized university OR Diploma (Minimum 2 years) in Dress Making/ Garment fabricating technology/ costume designing from recognized board of education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in Dress Making. Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (Fitter): B.Voc/ Degree in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/ recognized board of technical education OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Fitter". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (Sewing Technology): B.Voc/ Degree in Fashion & Apparel Technology from UGC recognized College/ university OR Diploma (Minimum 02 years) in Garment Fabrication Technology/ Costume Design & Dress Making from recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Sewing Technology" earlier named as "Cutting & Sewing". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC. Guest Instructor (TWPT): B.Voc/ Degree in Textile Technology/ Textile Chemistry from AICTE/ UGC recognized university/ College OR 03 years Diploma in Textile Technology/ Textile Processing from AICTE recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Trade of "Textile Wet Processing Technician". Experience: 1 year for B.Voc/ Degree, 2 years for Diploma, 3 years for NTC/ NAC.

content_sections.heading: Govt ITI Boudh Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 200/ - per hour for theory classes (maximum 16 hours per month). Rs. 150/ - per hour for practical classes (maximum 112 hours per month). Activities like checking records, internal examinations, maintenance of machines, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, innovative projects, industry visits, career counselling campaigns etc. are treated as practical hours for calculation of remuneration, with a maximum ceiling of Rs. 16,800/ - per month. The maximum remuneration for all posts is Rs. 20,000/ - per month.

content_sections.heading: Govt ITI Boudh Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Govt ITI Boudh Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Govt ITI Boudh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Guest Instructor posts released by Government Industrial Training Institute Boudh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Instructor posts will be conducted on 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by trade but generally include B.Voc/Degree, Diploma, or NTC/NAC in the relevant field with specified years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The salary is based on an hourly rate for theory and practical classes, with a maximum monthly remuneration of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for the Guest Instructor posts.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data/CV, self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates, passport-size photographs, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Bank Passbook/Account details, along with original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the Guest Instructor positions is Temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Which trades are covered under the Guest Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers trades such as Dress Making, Fitter, Sewing Technology, and TWPT (Textile Wet Processing Technician).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Government Industrial Training Institute Boudh located?
faq.answer: Government Industrial Training Institute Boudh is located in Boudh, Odisha, with the pincode 762026.
